meta.title: Add a Participant column (e.g. Freight Charges) for the vendor to fill
warnings: dropped vendor_bid — the case switches to the vendor's side to look, and never says the vendor bids
dropped vendor_bid — the case switches to the vendor's side to look, and never says the vendor bids

steps.note: Open the eRFX event creation screen.
Configure the event as an RFQ.
Apply an RFQ pricing template before adding line items.
Add a product so the RFQ sheet is available.
Complete the required RFQ sheet values.

args.goal: On the buyer's RFQ sheet, click Add Columns, choose Participant, select Freight Charges, and stop with the sheet visibly showing the Freight Charges column.

steps.note: Add and verify the Participant column, which has no dedicated catalog step.
Add a participating vendor for the verification step.
Assert that publication reached the event page.
Move to the invited vendor's supplier portal.
Open the event's RFQ bid sheet as the vendor.
Assert that the Participant column is visible to the vendor.
Enter a value in the Participant column as the vendor.
Assert that the vendor-entered value remains in the column.
Assert that the vendor bid was accepted.
